input: Hi! I'm helping organise my sister's wedding reception in Andheri, Mumbai, for 800 guests, and I need to finalise the non-veg catering quantities with our caterer by Friday for Sunday's dinner. The menu is fixed: chicken biryani and mutton rogan josh, plus the vegetarian dishes we've already confirmed. Food must not run out at any point during the 4-hour dinner, and the non-veg budget is up to ₹6,50,000. We absolutely cannot run short in front of guests, so we'd like it generous, the way the big Mumbai weddings do it; better too much than too little. Could you finalise the best plan for us? Thank you!

experiences.name: Banarasi Paan & Mukhwas Counter for 800
experiences.description: A festive after-dinner counter for 800 guests, with Banarasi and meetha paan made fresh by two paanwalas, plus a mukhwas selection. Silver-foil-free.

experiences.name: Shahi Dawat Caterers — Classic Shaadi Buffer Plan
experiences.description: A traditional 35% safety surplus, so the counters stay full until the very last guest. For 800 guests, prepares 162 kg chicken and 130 kg mutton (35% over estimated consumption). Unserved cooked food is discarded after the event. Chicken biryani and mutton rogan josh cooked in our Goregaon kitchen and served from chafing dishes by 12 service staff throughout the dinner.

experiences.name: Shahi Dawat Caterers — Smart Estimate + Live Top-Up Plan
experiences.description: Estimation-tool quantities with live kitchen top-ups, guaranteeing full counters until the last guest. For 800 guests, prepares 130 kg chicken and 104 kg mutton (8% over estimated consumption); an on-site kitchen holds 20 kg marinated chicken and pre-cooked mutton base to cook on demand. Unused raw stock is returned to cold storage for later use. Copper handis; 14 service staff.

experiences.name: Chatpata Live Chaat Station for 800
experiences.description: Three live counters serving pani puri and sev puri, with puris fried on site and tamarind and mint waters made fresh. Prepared without curd.

experiences.name: Shahi Dawat Caterers — Precision Banquet Plan
experiences.description: Headcount-matched quantities with a never-run-out guarantee, refilled in batches. For 800 guests, prepares 132 kg chicken and 106 kg mutton (10% over estimated consumption), cooked in three timed batches matched to guest flow; the final batch is cooked only if needed. Batch-cooked in Goregaon and delivered by insulated van every 75 minutes; served from chafing dishes by 14 service staff.

experiences.name: Shahi Dawat Caterers — Royal Generous Plan
experiences.description: Our signature big-wedding quantity, with a never-run-out guarantee and 40% extra over headcount. For 800 guests, prepares 168 kg chicken and 134 kg mutton (40% over the estimated 120 kg / 96 kg consumption). Unserved cooked food is discarded after the event. Chicken biryani and mutton rogan josh cooked in our Goregaon kitchen, delivered in copper handis and served by 12 service staff.

experiences.name: Konkan Kokum & Fresh-Lime Mocktail Bar for 800
experiences.description: A refreshing mocktail bar with kokum sherbet from the Konkan and fresh-lime soda, served in glassware by four bar staff throughout the evening.
